basics.name: Osmar Alejandro Betancourt Avello
basics.label: Tech Leader & End-to-End AI Platform Engineer (Full Stack · Cloud · DevSecOps · MCPs / AI Agents)
basics.summary: End-to-end AI platform engineer and software-agency founder with 5+ years of experience. Architects and ships production systems across the whole stack: self-hosted Kubernetes handling millions of requests/day, multi-service backends (Django, Rust, Node), native iOS/Android apps, and AI-agent/LLM integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, MCP), owning delivery from architecture through cloud/IaC, CI/CD, observability, and DevSecOps.

work.name: DreamIT Software
work.summary: End-to-end software consultancy & development agency ('if you can dream it, we can build it'). Delivers full platforms for clients from architecture and cloud infrastructure to backend, frontend, native mobile, and operations.
highlights: Founded an end-to-end software agency delivering full platforms for clients: architecture, cloud infrastructure, backend, frontend, native mobile, and ongoing operations.
Architected and shipped production systems across a wide stack: high-traffic platforms on self-hosted Kubernetes, multi-service backends (Django, Rust/Axum, Node), and native iOS/Android apps.
Own the full delivery lifecycle: cloud/IaC (AWS CloudFormation, OpenTofu), CI/CD, observability (Prometheus/Grafana/Loki), and DevSecOps, while acting as the direct technical contact for clients.

work.name: Moneybook
work.position: Tech Leader & End-to-End AI Platform Engineer
highlights: Designed and implemented the full AWS architecture and DevOps strategy for a virtual AI assistant platform focused on bank debt collection.
Developed the entire backend in Django, containerized with Docker and Kubernetes for scalable deployments.
Engineered a custom AI agent using the OpenAI Agents SDK and Model Context Protocol (MCP).

highlights: Led technical projects and teams, software validation, and AI solution design (Jira / customer chatbots).
Delivered full-stack software solutions and deployed AI agents within cloud environments.
Main technical representative in customer meetings; mentored and trained new team members.

work.name: Solutions for Everyone (S4E)
highlights: Coordinated technical projects using agile methodologies (Kanban, Scrum).
Automated software creation processes, reducing delivery time from 30 hours to 2 hours.
Managed successful Jira and AWS integrations across cross-functional teams.

projects.name: High-Traffic Real-Time Emergency-Response Platform (self-hosted Kubernetes)
projects.description: Architected and operated a public crisis-mapping platform sustaining ~3M requests/day (measured in Cloudflare) with zero downtime. Provisioned a k3s cluster as code with OpenTofu; tuned HPA (API pods 3→30) plus cluster-autoscaler for emergency spikes; shielded Postgres with PgBouncer and a Cloudflare+Valkey caching/rate-limit edge; ran Prometheus/Grafana/Loki observability and a DevSecOps CI pipeline.

projects.name: Multi-Domain Work-Management & Analytics Platform
projects.description: ClickUp/Jira-class internal platform spanning 32 domain services (billing, capacity, boards, HR, automation, ingestion, analytics, permissions, Jira/GitHub integrations). Deployed on AWS defined entirely in CloudFormation: EC2 ASG behind ALB, RDS Postgres with streaming read-replica, ElastiCache, S3, CloudFront.

projects.name: Native iOS App: On-Device Computer Vision & Real-Time Voice
projects.description: Native SwiftUI app (iOS 18) performing on-device face-landmark analysis with Apple Vision + AVFoundation (no server round-trip). Real-time SSE event stream, live voice assistant, Siri App Intent, notification-service extension; XcodeGen project.

projects.name: Multi-Tenant Analytics SaaS in Rust
projects.description: Type-safe async analytics backend in Rust (Axum, SeaORM, Tokio, sqlx) with OpenAPI docs, Docker/Caddy CI. Sibling financial build adds a daily prod→local data-sync with read-only schema isolation for safe analytics on production data.

projects.name: Native Android app · pgvector multi-worker backend · MCP servers
projects.description: Native Android (Kotlin/Jetpack Compose) companion app; a pgvector + multi-worker (BullMQ) Node backend with self-hosted Prometheus/Loki/Grafana; and custom MCP servers (Jira/Render/Outline/GitHub) with hand-rolled OAuth 2.1 + PKCE.

projects.name: Self-hosted infrastructure
projects.description: Owns the full stack down to DNS and mail: self-hosted Mailu mail server (Postfix/Dovecot/Rspamd/Unbound), HashiCorp Vault / Vaultwarden, and Outline wiki, fronted by Caddy with a Prometheus/Grafana/Loki observability stack.
